nodes.description: Private owner address in UniswapExchange controlling all privileged functions
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances
Public nested mapping of spender allowances
Private mapping counting the number of sales per address
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass sale conditions
Private minimum sale amount in token units
Private maximum sale amount in token units
Private number of allowed sales per address
Whitelisted trade address that bypasses ensure()
Public total token supply
Constant decimals value (18) used for scaling
Constant UNI router address 0x7a25... hardcoded in the token
transfer(address _to, uint _value) forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender
ensure(address,address,uint) whitelist/condition gate using owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) performs allowance check and raw balance arithmetic
approve(address _spender, uint _value) writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
condition(address,uint) view enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale and _onSaleNum limits
delegate(address a, bytes b) owner-only arbitrary delegatecall
_mints(address,uint256) privileged mint that sets balanceOf and canSale whitelist
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) owner-only configuration of sale limits
batchSend(address[],uint) owner-only batch transfer with unchecked multiplication
setTradeAddress(address) owner-only setter of tradeAddress whitelist
pairFor computes the deterministic Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hash
UniswapExchange constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and allowance
Context._msgSender() returning msg.sender as address payable
msg.sender untrusted caller used for ownership, allowance and mint authorization
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary calldata in this contract's storage context
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction allowing underflow
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition allowing overflow
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction
total = _value * _tos.length performed without SafeMath overflow guard

edges.reason: transfer's _to parameter flows into the transferFrom call as recipient
transfer's _value parameter flows into the transferFrom call as amount
transfer delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as _from
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender via _msgSender
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value
transferFrom compares msg.sender to _from to consume allowance
_from parameter of transferFrom feeds balance and allowance lookups
_to parameter of transferFrom feeds balanceOf credit
_value parameter of transferFrom feeds allowance and balance arithmetic
transferFrom invokes ensure() as a transfer gate before mutating state
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value which can underflow
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value which can overflow
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer
ensure's _from parameter is checked against whitelists
ensure's _to parameter is checked against owner
ensure's _value parameter is forwarded to condition()
_UNI local computed by pairFor is compared against _from in ensure
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address
ensure calls condition() to enforce sale limits
ensure compares _from and _to against the owner state variable
ensure reads the canSale whitelist mapping
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress whitelist
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI address
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce per-address sale count
condition reads _minSale lower bound
condition reads _maxSale upper bound
condition reads _saleNum global sale limit
approve's _spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping
approve's _value parameter is written into the allowance mapping
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
delegate's target address a is the delegatecall destination
delegate's calldata b is forwarded to delegatecall
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before arbitrary delegatecall
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) giving full control of contract storage
_mints's spender parameter receives minted balance and whitelist flag
_mints's addedValue parameter is scaled and assigned as balance
_mints restricts caller to owner or a hardcoded address
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] without updating totalSupply
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true bypassing sale conditions
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals
init's saleNum parameter writes _saleNum
init's token parameter writes _minSale
init's maxToken parameter writes _maxSale
init requires msg.sender == owner to reconfigure sale limits
init writes the _minSale state variable
init writes the _maxSale state variable
init writes the _saleNum state variable
init uses decimals for scaling sale bounds
batchSend's _tos recipient array drives the transfer loop
batchSend's _value parameter is credited to each recipient
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for sender and recipients
_tos.length feeds the unchecked _value * _tos.length product
_value feeds the unchecked total computation in batchSend
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath
the total local is derived from the _value parameter
local total is compared against balanceOf[msg.sender] and subtracted
loop index i is used to iterate the batchSend recipients
loop local _to receives each batch recipient address
setTradeAddress's addr parameter is stored as tradeAddress
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender granting total control
constructor writes the owner state variable
constructor writes totalSupply from the _supply argument
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply
constructor pre-approves the UNI router with uint(-1)
constructor scales _supply by 10**decimals
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI constant address
pairFor output is used by ensure as the _UNI whitelist address
